scene_objective: In the Setup phase, hook the reader by showing Ben Skywalker losing a sparring exchange he should never lose due to an unnamed wrongness in the Force, establishing his private isolation as a Jedi Knight handling a growing personal problem that has now become visible to others, while planting the promise of a larger disturbance without naming or diagnosing it.

turning_point.trigger: Running a form without igniting the blade in the empty salle, where the half-beat lag in the ambient Force field steals a timing beat he cannot spare
turning_point.shift: Ben stops pretending the disturbance is mere fatigue or residue from recent crises and internally admits it is something real and persistent that is eroding his reliability
turning_point.cost: A deepening frustrated isolation that reinforces his reluctance to speak aloud about the wrongness, widening the gap between him and other Knights who dismiss it

closing_beat: Luke appears in the doorway with a datapad and an expression Ben knows means a mission

emotional_arc.start: restless unease from the accumulating half-beat lags costing him in combat
emotional_arc.shift: frustrated isolation when he waves off his sparring partner and paces alone, unable to voice the problem
emotional_arc.end: reluctant hope sparked by the sight of Luke and the implied new mission

key_beats.beat_description: Ben's guard drops a half-second late during the spar; his partner's training blade catches him across the shoulder
key_beats.state_change: Physical hit lands, ending the exchange and forcing Ben to deactivate his saber
key_beats.pov_reaction: A spike of irritation at the lag, followed by the impulse to hide the real cause behind a casual deflection

key_beats.beat_description: Ben waves off a rematch, claiming fatigue, and the sparring partner exits
key_beats.state_change: Salle empties; ambient sounds shift to distant corridor foot traffic and a cleaning droid
key_beats.pov_reaction: Self-deprecating internal jab at how the week has worn him down, yet knowing this isn't the full truth

key_beats.beat_description: Ben paces the salle alone and runs through forms without igniting the blade to test muscle memory versus Force timing
key_beats.state_change: Body moves through familiar patterns but the half-beat lag in the ambient field disrupts rhythm, causing a visible stumble
key_beats.pov_reaction: A jolt of reluctant admission that this isn't fatigue; the vibrational wrongness is stealing beats he cannot afford, tightening his jaw

key_beats.beat_description: Ben pauses mid-form, sweat cooling on his skin, listening to the salle's delayed Force presence
key_beats.state_change: Physical stance shifts from active testing to a momentary still posture against a wall
key_beats.pov_reaction: Sharp, non-melodramatic frustration at his own unreliability, with a fleeting wish that someone else would notice without him having to explain

voice_guidance: Channel Zahn's efficient, close third-person style with sharp, self-deprecating interior voice; keep internal monologue grounded, pragmatic, and never melodramatic or clinically diagnostic. Dialogue minimal and functional. Surface dry wit in one beat where Ben internally ribs himself about measuring against legacy without naming it outright. Support commercial SW EU pacing with physical action and environmental interaction framing any interior moments.
forbidden_moves: Do not allow any character outside Ben Skywalker and the unnamed Jedi Knight sparring partner to have dialogue, significant action, or meaningful interaction
Do not have Ben arrive at any clinical or structural articulation of the wrongness
Do not resolve or pay off the planted promises about the wrongness's source or Ben's Skywalker shadow
Do not introduce or re-explain established post-Abeloth Force sensitivity concepts from scratch
anti_patterns: do not describe the wrongness in visual or color terms
keep it auditory and vibrational, and use one consistent metaphor for this scene (the half-beat lag in the ambient field)
he should not, in this scene, arrive at any clinical articulation of what the wrongness is
If a sentence of his interiority could be lifted into a mission debrief, it is too composed for this scene
